aiPlan.title: Allowance and plan
aiPlan.hint: Read vendor balances and plan windows. Authorize plans that require a platform sign-in here.
aiPlan.saveFirst: Save this connection and its keys before reading allowances or signing in to a plan.
aiPlan.ended: The platform session expired. Sign in again before reading allowances.
aiPlan.pasteHint: Copy the reader script and save it as a browser bookmark. Sign in to the platform, click that bookmark, then paste the copied session below.
aiPlan.empty: The vendor returned no allowance or balance.
aiPlan.deferred: No vendor request was made; showing the saved reading.
